newsitem.title: USA: ADRs showed strong growth last year - Citibank.
newsitem.headline: ADRs showed strong growth last year - Citibank.

text.p: The market for American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) soared in 1996, with trading volumes reaching record highs, Citibank said on Thursday.

The dollar value of ADR shares traded on U.S. stock exchanges hit $345 billion last year, up 26 percent from 1995. The total number of ADR shares traded also increased, rising to 11 billion, up 10 percent from the previous year, Citibank said in a statement.
The rise was fueled by investors pouring money into ADRs and new companies issuing ADR programs, especially from emerging markets.

By the end of 1996, 252 companies from 48 countries had launched new ADR programs, up 34 percent from 1995. About 130, or 52 percent, of these companies were from emerging markets, up from 40 percent the year before.
The most active issuing market was Britain, with 30 companies launching new programs, the statement said.
Based on total dollar value of trading, the top ADRs over the past five years were Telefonos de Mexico TMXI.MX, Royal Dutch Petroleum Co and Sweden's LM Ericsson Telephone Corp.
